hide_effect_icons.configuration.title: %s Configuration
hide_effect_icons.configuration.hide_eff: Hides potion/status effect icons in the top-right HUD without hiding the inventory-side effect list.
hide_effect_icons.configuration.hide_own: Hides potion/status effect particles emitted by your own player without affecting other players or normal world particles.
hide_effect_icons.configuration.hide_fir: Hides the first-person fire overlay while burning without extinguishing the player or changing fire damage.
hide_effect_icons.configuration.hide_lig: Hides the visual rendering of lightning bolt entities without affecting lightning damage, fire ignition, or lightning rods.
Hides lightning-triggered sky/fog whiteout flash and world lightmap flash without modifying vanilla accessibility options.
hide_effect_icons.configuration.mute_lig: Mutes client-side thunder and lightning impact sounds without affecting rain or other weather sounds.
